name: Testing Fee Reimbursement Scheme
benefit: - **Testing Fee Reimbursement:** Up to 80% of the testing fee or ₹1,00,000/- (excluding GST), whichever is lower.  - **Coverage of Testing:** Includes testing of raw materials, semi-finished goods, and finished products.  - **Multiple Claims Allowed:** Enterprises can avail reimbursement multiple times in a financial year, subject to the overall limit.  - **Support for Certification:** Assistance
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should have a micro or small scale industry. - Applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST). - The enterprise must be registered with the Udyam portal or any other valid registration platform recognized by the MSME Ministry.
